tasks.name: Beam Prediction
tasks.description: Predict suitable current or future transmit or receive beams from wireless, positional, sensory, or multimodal observations.

tasks.name: Beam Selection
tasks.description: Select one or more suitable transmit or receive beams from a predefined or learned beam set using currently available observations.

tasks.name: Beam Tracking
tasks.description: Maintain or predict beam alignment over time for mobile users, devices, or access points.

tasks.name: Blockage Prediction
tasks.description: Predict future blockage or link-state degradation affecting a wireless link from radio and/or auxiliary observations.

tasks.name: Channel Charting
tasks.description: Learn a low-dimensional representation of channel observations that preserves relevant radio-geometric neighborhood structure.

tasks.name: Channel Estimation
tasks.description: Estimate the wireless channel or its parameters from received observations, pilots, or other measurements.

tasks.name: Channel Extrapolation
tasks.description: Infer channel information at unobserved frequencies, antennas, spatial locations, or related channel domains from observed channel data.

tasks.name: Channel Prediction
tasks.description: Predict future wireless channel states or channel parameters from past and/or current observations.

tasks.name: Cooperative Localization
tasks.description: Estimate positions using measurements, information, or learned representations shared among multiple wireless nodes or agents.

tasks.name: CSI Feedback
tasks.description: Represent, compress, encode, or reconstruct channel state information for feedback from a receiver to a transmitter.

tasks.name: Device-Free Localization
tasks.description: Estimate the location of a person or object that does not carry or actively operate the wireless device producing the measurements.

tasks.name: Gesture Recognition
tasks.description: Recognize human gestures or fine-grained motion patterns from wireless sensing measurements.

tasks.name: Handover Prediction
tasks.description: Predict handover events, target cells, or handover-related outcomes from radio, mobility, and network measurements.

tasks.name: Human Activity Recognition
tasks.description: Infer human activities or activity classes from wireless measurements such as CSI, radar, RSS, or related radio observations.

tasks.name: Interference Classification
tasks.description: Detect or classify interference sources, interference types, or interference conditions affecting wireless communication.

tasks.name: Localization
tasks.description: Estimate the position or location of a wireless device, user, transmitter, receiver, or target from wireless and/or auxiliary observations.

tasks.name: Mobility Prediction
tasks.description: Predict future user, device, or node mobility states relevant to wireless network operation.

tasks.name: Modulation Recognition
tasks.description: Identify the modulation format of a received wireless signal from I/Q samples, spectra, or derived signal representations.

tasks.name: Network Anomaly Detection
tasks.description: Detect anomalous behavior, measurements, events, or operating conditions in wireless networks from network data.

tasks.name: Network Fault Diagnosis
tasks.description: Identify, classify, or localize faults and failure causes in wireless network infrastructure or operation from observed network data.

tasks.name: Pose Estimation
tasks.description: Estimate human body pose, keypoints, or posture from wireless sensing measurements.

tasks.name: Power Control
tasks.description: Determine transmit-power decisions for wireless links or users from channel, interference, and network state information.

tasks.name: Presence Detection
tasks.description: Detect whether one or more people or relevant targets are present in an environment using wireless sensing measurements.

tasks.name: Radio-Assisted Navigation
tasks.description: Select routes, waypoints, motion actions, or navigation policies using wireless measurements or radio-derived spatial information to guide an agent toward a destination.
tasks.notes: Localization or trajectory data alone does not establish this task. A verified mapping requires documented navigation, path/waypoint selection, motion guidance, or action/policy use.

tasks.name: Radio Map Estimation
tasks.description: Construct, complete, interpolate, or predict spatial maps of radio measurements or channel-related quantities over an environment.

tasks.name: Radio SLAM
tasks.description: Jointly estimate agent trajectory and radio-related map or landmark states from wireless measurements, optionally with auxiliary sensing.
tasks.notes: Radio-SLAM may be snapshot or sequential. Dataset suitability from geometry/path labels is distinct from a verified task mapping, which requires documented SLAM use.

tasks.name: Resource Allocation
tasks.description: Allocate wireless communication resources such as spectrum, time, power, or spatial resources using observed network state.

tasks.name: RF Fingerprinting
tasks.description: Identify or authenticate wireless transmitters or devices using distinctive characteristics present in their emitted radio signals.

tasks.name: Signal Classification
tasks.description: Assign received wireless signals to predefined signal, protocol, waveform, or emitter-related classes beyond modulation recognition alone.

tasks.name: Spectrum Sensing
tasks.description: Detect and characterize spectrum occupancy or transmission activity in one or more frequency bands from wireless observations.

tasks.name: Traffic Classification
tasks.description: Classify network traffic, applications, or service types from packet-level observations, RAN KPIs, or related network measurements.
tasks.notes: This task concerns network/application traffic rather than RF waveform or modulation classification.

tasks.name: Traffic Prediction
tasks.description: Predict future communication traffic volume, demand, or load from historical network observations and contextual information.

tasks.name: User Scheduling
tasks.description: Select and schedule users, links, or transmissions over wireless resources based on current or predicted network state.

tasks.name: Vital Sign Sensing
tasks.description: Estimate physiological signals such as respiration or heart activity from wireless sensing measurements.
